Modern.brandNameRationale: Last mile is the logistics term for the final segment of a delivery — from the local hub to the recipient's door. The phrase carries the full weight of the courier industry's hardest, most expensive, most service-defining work.
Modern.industrySummary: Modern same-day courier brands compete on app polish and speed promise. There is room for a city-focused operator whose entire identity is the segment of the trip the customer actually experiences — the last mile.
Modern.competitorLandscape: Roadie (roadie.com) holds the same-day platform peer. Stuart (stuart.com) is the European city-courier precedent. Veho (shipveho.com) is the modern e-commerce last-mile reference. We sit closer to Stuart in posture, sharper on the city.
Modern.positioningStatement: A modern city-only courier operator built around the last mile.

targetAudience.primary: Small businesses, e-commerce sellers, and design studios sending one to fifty packages a day across a single city.

dos: Show the time and the route
Photograph the bike, not the rider

Modern.logoDirection: A wordmark only — LAST MILE set in a tight modern grotesk, all caps, with a small route-line mark as the favicon — a curved line ending in a dot.

typography.primary: GT America for the wordmark and dashboards
typography.secondary: GT America Mono for tracking IDs and times
typography.rationale: One family. The mono carries the tracking data, the regular carries the brand.

Luxury.brandNameRationale: A bonded courier carries a surety bond — a financial guarantee against loss or theft, used historically for legal documents, jewelry, and high-value goods. Bonded & Co. places the brand in the trusted-courier tradition with the trade word at the front.
Luxury.industrySummary: Heritage bonded couriers are a small enduring segment serving law firms, auction houses, and private clients. There is room for a small heritage operator built around the bond, the briefcase, and the named courier.
Luxury.competitorLandscape: Crozier Fine Arts (crozierfinearts.com) holds the fine-art logistics peer. Brink's (brinks.com) is the institutional secure-transport peer. Malca-Amit (malca-amit.com) is the precedent. We sit between Crozier and Malca-Amit in posture, smaller in scale.
Luxury.positioningStatement: A heritage bonded-courier service for legal documents, art, and high-value goods.

targetAudience.primary: Law firms, auction houses, and private clients sending insured high-value items between cities.

dos: Name the courier on the dispatch

Luxury.logoDirection: A serif wordmark — Bonded & Co. set in a classical roman, with a small wax-seal hallmark, foiled in brass on the chain-of-custody log.

typography.primary: Canela for the wordmark and chain-of-custody
typography.secondary: Söhne for the secure client portal
typography.rationale: Canela carries the heritage register. Söhne handles the booking portal.

Minimal.brandNameRationale: Rushly is a coined adverbial — the act of rushing rendered as a brand-friendly suffix. Six letters, one syllable past the verb, easy to say, easy to type, easy to read on a sticker on the package.
Minimal.industrySummary: Minimal courier brands are rare — the category leans loud (orange, urgent, all caps). There is room for a small operator whose entire identity is the calm verb — one word, one sticker, one promise.
Minimal.competitorLandscape: Postmates Same-Day (postmates.com) holds the institutional on-demand peer. Gophr (gophr.com) is the UK on-demand precedent. Borzo (borzodelivery.com) is the European peer. We sit smaller, sharper on the calm.
Minimal.positioningStatement: A minimal same-day courier for one-package senders.

targetAudience.primary: Individuals and very small businesses sending one package at a time within a city.
behaviors: Books one delivery at a time
Reads the confirmation, not the marketing

dos: Show the price and the ETA
Send the confirmation in one line

Minimal.logoDirection: A wordmark only — Rushly set in a single-weight grotesk, lowercase. The favicon is a small horizontal arrow.

typography.primary: Neue Haas Grotesk for the wordmark
typography.secondary: Neue Haas Grotesk Mono for tracking IDs
typography.rationale: One family. The mono carries the tracking IDs, the regular carries the brand.

Corporate.brandNameRationale: By hand today is the operating promise of the urgent-courier industry stripped to four words. The phrase has the register of a contract clause — short, specific, contractually meaningful — and positions the brand as a business-to-business operator.
Corporate.industrySummary: Corporate same-day operators run dedicated courier services for law firms, hospitals, and B2B logistics. There is room for an operator whose name is the deliverable, with a single-city focus and a monthly invoice model.
Corporate.competitorLandscape: PostNet (postnet.com) holds the institutional courier-services peer. Quiqup (quiqup.com) is the B2B same-day precedent. Hackett Logistics (hackettlogistics.com) is the precedent. We sit smaller, focused on documents and small parcels.
Corporate.positioningStatement: A B2B same-day courier for documents and small parcels, monthly invoice.

targetAudience.primary: Office managers, law firm operations, and medical practices booking five to thirty same-day deliveries a week.

Corporate.logoDirection: A wordmark with a hallmark — By Hand Today set in a clean grotesk, paired with a small hand-and-package pictogram reduced to two strokes.

typography.primary: Inter for the wordmark and rate card
typography.secondary: Source Serif Pro for printed contracts and rate cards
typography.rationale: Inter scales clean across the dashboard. The serif handles the printed contract.

Creative.brandNameRationale: Whisk is the friendly fast-action verb — to whisk a package away, to whisk something across town. Single syllable, one motion, easy to say to a friend. The verb does the work the urgent-courier industry usually does with all-caps and orange.
Creative.industrySummary: Creative courier brands compete on personality and bike-messenger lineage. There is room for a small bike-courier operator whose identity is the friendly verb, with hand-drawn route maps and a personable dispatch.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Swoop (swoop.com) holds the friendly-courier slot. Pedal Movement (pedalmovement.com) is the bike-courier precedent. Cyclehoop (cyclehoop.com) is the urban-cycling peer. We sit closer to Pedal Movement in posture, sharper on the verb.
Creative.positioningStatement: A creative bike-courier service for small businesses and creative studios.

targetAudience.primary: Design studios, small shops, and creative agencies sending one to ten packages a day across a single city.
behaviors: Pays by invoice every two weeks

dos: Hand-draw the route on the confirmation
Sign the dispatch by the dispatcher's name

Creative.logoDirection: A wordmark with a hand-drawn motion mark — Whisk set in a friendly humanist sans, with a small swooping line as the favicon.

typography.primary: ABC Diatype for the wordmark and signage
typography.secondary: ABC Diatype Mono for pickup times
typography.rationale: One family. The mono carries the times, the regular carries the brand.
